A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same π-Flow and imitation-distillation work. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices A–G are readable and support reliable matching across the revision.

before.justification: v1 reports original ImageNet and text-to-image experiments, quantitative ablations, and an Appendix D human-preference study comparing π-Flow with FLUX.1 schnell.

after.justification: v2 retains those original empirical results and adds inference-time measurements and a controlled GMFlow factorization experiment.

M1.justification: The DX and GMFlow policies, π-ID training procedures, dropout, trajectory mixing, temperature scaling, and micro-window matching are retained. Appendix F's revised formulas are algebraically equivalent after rescaling auxiliary variables and removing a component-independent logit term.

E1.justification: ImageNet, the captioned image training data, COCO-10k, HPSv2, and OneIG-Bench coverage remain unchanged. The added timing and fixed-prompt factorization experiments stay within the existing text-to-image task and domain.

E2.justification: Existing benchmark comparisons and the FLUX.1 schnell appendix retain their comparator membership. The new timing comparison reuses Qwen-Image Lightning. Newly cited BOOT and flow map matching are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: v2 adds separate network/policy timing measurements for 4-NFE models, averaging 32 policy substeps per network evaluation. Appendix C.1 adds direct optimization of K=32 GM parameters for 4000 iterations with fixed noise and prompt, without a student network. Existing benchmark protocols remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Appendix C.1 and new Figure 11 compare element-wise, pixel-wise, and patch-wise factorization to isolate the policy's inductive bias. Existing dropout, temperature, micro-window, and convergence analyses remain; v1 Table 6 becomes v2 Table 7 without changing its ablation results.

E5.justification: There are no added or revised repeated-run counts, seed identifiers, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The new timing and factorization results do not introduce uncertainty estimation.

E6.justification: New Table 6 reports network/policy times of 0.464/0.015 seconds for DX-Qwen and 0.465/0.014 seconds for GM-Qwen, versus 0.465 seconds for Qwen-Image Lightning's network. Figure 11 adds qualitative factorization findings. Existing benchmark scores, ablation values, and human-preference results are unchanged.

T1.justification: Section 4 adds O(nε) versus O(n²ε) error-bound claims and a convergence statement attributed to Ross et al. (2011), without adding a proof. The expressiveness theorems and Appendix E proofs remain unchanged. Appendix F's algebraic reformulation does not establish a different mathematical result.

C1.justification: The abstract narrows the diversity-superiority comparison from state-of-the-art few-step methods generally to state-of-the-art DMD models. The central policy-generation and imitation-distillation contributions, headline ImageNet result, and conclusion are retained.

C2.justification: Appendix C.1 now interprets the controlled factorization experiment as evidence favoring pixel-wise policy factorization. Section 6 distinguishes VSD's mode-collapse risk from GAN/SiD style drift, replacing the earlier broader diversity-loss characterization. Existing teacher-robustness limitations remain.

D1.justification: The new timing table specifies an A100 GPU and 12 CPU cores at 3.0 GHz. Appendix C.1 documents the toy experiment's component count, optimization duration, fixed inputs, and direct parameter optimization. Existing training hyperparameters and code-access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds Gu et al.'s BOOT and Boffi et al.'s flow map matching references to the consistency-model discussion. It also refines its comparison with FACM and its characterization of distribution-matching methods, while retaining the overall positioning against shortcut prediction.

P1.justification: There are localized abstract and related-work revisions, an expanded GMFlow explanation, new error-bound and inference-time paragraphs, and added Appendix C.1 discussion. Notation is simplified in the algorithms and Appendix F. The overall section and appendix organization remains intact.

P2.justification: v2 adds inference-time Table 6 and factorization Figure 11. The existing temperature/micro-window ablation table is reformatted into checkmark columns. Subsequent displays are renumbered and page content reflows, while existing image panels are retained.

improvement.justification: Table 6 directly supports the previously asserted small policy overhead, measuring approximately 3% of network time. Appendix C.1 adds controlled evidence for the existing factorization choice. These improve empirical justification, although the additions cover one hardware configuration and a fixed-prompt toy study, and the new convergence discussion supplies no paper-specific proof.
